question:
These volcanoes are mostly made up of basalt, a type of lava that is very fluid when erupted. For this reason, these volcanoes are not steep.

Which of the following volcano is an example of the above given type of volcano?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Hawaiian Volcano__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shield Volcano**

 
 
• **Shield volcanoes** are named for their** low, broad profile**, which resembles a warrior's shield lying on the ground.
 
• They are** formed** by the **eruption of highly fluid (low viscosity) lava**, **which can travel farther and forms thinner layers compared to the more viscous lava erupted from stratovolcanoes**.
 
• **As a result** of the fluid nature of the lava they erupt, **shield volcanoes have gentle slopes and vast base areas**.
 
• **Many shield volcanoes**, such as** Mauna Loa in Hawaii**, are located in the** basin of the Pacific Ocean**, **commonly known **as the **Pacific Ring of Fire**.
